title: disappointed, hidden charges and app quality has gone downhill
body:
This app has become a money grab.
I have used this app for a long time, but the current version is extremely disappointing.
The biggest issue is the subscription trap. I signed up for a trial expecting a trial experience, but I was charged afterward without a clear enough reminder. I have reported this to Apple because this kind of payment experience is not acceptable.
What makes it worse is that the app itself is getting worse every year. The workouts are outdated, repetitive, and lack creativity. It feels like the team is recycling old content instead of creating new and useful fitness programs. For a paid fitness app, the lack of fresh content is unacceptable.
I also noticed that critical reviews disappear, which makes me question how much the company values honest user feedback.
This app used to have potential, but now it feels like the priority is getting subscriptions rather than delivering a quality fitness experience.
Save your money and look for a better fitness app.

title: Toxic Fitness Culture
body: Good app overall for daily fitness training. I just have a few thoughts. I feel this app is objectifying women’s bodies rather than focusing on heath or strength. Plays into toxic fitness culture and manipulative marketing. When you first get started by choosing your “body type” and “goals” the imagery of the women is unreal. Cartoonish women that are busty, skinny waist, wide hips. Not how real women look. And then when you answer the motivational prompts, they ask like “do you want to get fit?” And u click yes. But then they ask you “do you want to be attractive?” This is not a motivational question to lift women up. A much better question would be “do you want to feel strong?” Or something like it. Very disappointed by this.
